description.en: Know Your Customer (KYC) regulatory compliance platform and batch processing routines for Natixis Corporate & Investment Banking. Spring Boot 2, Spring Batch 3, Oracle SQL, and Angular 11 with Jenkins/XL Deploy pipelines.
description.pt: Plataforma de conformidade regulatória KYC (Know Your Customer) e rotinas batch para a Natixis CIB. Desenvolvida em Spring Boot 2, Spring Batch 3, Oracle SQL, Hibernate JPA e Angular 11 com esteiras Jenkins/XL Deploy.
description.fr: Plateforme de conformité réglementaire KYC et traitements par lots pour Natixis CIB. Développée avec Spring Boot 2, Spring Batch 3, Oracle SQL, Hibernate JPA et Angular 11.
